title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Yukino Bijin…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow Yukino Bijin's line of sight to find a claw machine filled with a popular type of Umamusume plushies called Cuties.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's full of Cuties now! The prizes were completely diff'rent last time I was here.
choice_data_list: They change out the prizes pretty often.
They change out the prizes pretty often.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly… The prizes in the claw machines back home've been the same my whole life.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I guess that mean if there's someth'n I want, I've gotta snatch it up straight away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Well, they're just so charm'n! Don't you think? I never really saw any back home.
choice_data_list: I'll get you one if you want.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-you will?! Well, I think I'll have t'take you up on that offer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
